SPECIMEN IDENTIFICATION & CLINICAL DATA
Specimen: Core Needle Biopsy, Right Breast.
Procedure Date: 2026-01-08
Clinical History: Palpable right breast mass in upper-outer quadrant.
GROSS / MACROSCOPIC DESCRIPTION
Received in formalin labeled with synthetic patient ID SYN-CANCER-001 are four (4) core needle biopsy fragments. The tissue cores
range in length from 1.1 cm to 1.6 cm, with a uniform diameter of 0.1 cm. Color is tan-white to fibrofatty. Entire specimen submitted in one
cassette (Block A1).
PROCESSING PROTOCOL
Standard formalin fixation (18 hours), automated paraffin embedding, 4-micron microtomy sections, and routine Hematoxylin & Eosin
(H&E;) staining performed. Immunohistochemical (IHC) profiling initiated.

MICROSCOPIC DESCRIPTION & FINAL DOCUMENTED FINDINGS
Sections demonstrate invasive carcinoma with glandular and corded architectural patterns. Tubule formation is moderate. Nuclei exhibit
moderate pleomorphism with occasional visible mitotic figures. Surrounding stroma reveals desmoplastic reaction with minimal
lymphocytic infiltrate.
Documented Histopathology Diagnosis:
Pathology report documents: Invasive ductal carcinoma, histological Nottingham grade 2. Estrogen receptor (ER) positive (85%),
Progesterone receptor (PR) positive (70%), HER2 negative (score 1+ by IHC). Ki-67 index: 15%.
